name: real_leo
title: Real LEO
description: Every active LEO satellite from CelesTrak's active catalogue (about 15,000), with six operators in the federation: Starlink, Kuiper, OneWeb, Planet, Spire and ICEYE, grouped by satellite name. Everything else is in the sky but belongs to no member. Foster Pc. Nothing is engineered: every encounter is real TLE geometry, and a day holds a few real cross-operator close approaches (mostly Planet with Starlink) among many in-house ones. TLEs go stale within days, so the clock replays the first 7 days and then starts that week again.
